description: Four-channel mixer with panning, mutes and a master fader

params.text: Sets that channel's level into the mix, -60dB to +6dB, and the handle lights with the signal leaving that channel
Moves that channel between the left and right outputs
Silences that channel while it is on
Sets the level of the stereo mix, -60dB to +6dB
Silences the whole mix while it is on
Cuts the mix by -12dB while it is on, or by -6dB, -18dB or -24dB if the menu says so

inputs.text: 0-10V attenuated by that channel's fader, setting its level in the mix
±5V attenuverted by that channel's PAN knob, moving it between the outputs
The signal into that channel; a polyphonic cable patched here is summed to one channel
0-10V attenuated by the master fader, setting the level of the mix

outputs.text: The left side of the stereo mix, carrying the whole mix in mono when nothing is patched to R
The right side of the stereo mix, carrying the whole mix in mono when nothing is patched to L

notes: outputs are stereo, and mono if only one is patched
right-click a mute to solo that channel
menu: Linear level CV response — the level CV inputs act linearly in amplitude, so 5V halves the level the fader sets, instead of acting in decibels
Dim amount — how far the DIM button cuts the master: -6dB, -12dB, -18dB or -24dB
Input 1 poly spread — spreads a polyphonic cable at input 1 across the four channels: None, Channels 1-4, Channels 5-8, Channels 9-12 or Channels 13-16
